capabilities: Chat with an AI agent that reads, searches and edits vault files
Stream live reasoning and tool calls while tasks run
Run multiple parallel sessions with queue, interject and cancel
Attach notes to requests with @-mentions or the active note
Export conversations as Markdown notes with frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a standalone AI chat client; it shells out to the locally installed dsh CLI rather than calling an AI API itself.
extras: Desktop-only (spawns a local node process). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Provider is fixed to deepseek-official, and a 'danger-full-access' permission mode gives the agent unrestricted file access.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can act on vault files directly, so working with notes via AI normally means copying content in and out manually.

relations.evidence: Embed DSH (DeepSeek Harness) as the single AI agent inside your Obsidian vault.

summary: AI agent wrapper that embeds the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) CLI in the vault, offering multi-session chat that can read, search and edit notes.
